skills.name: Windrider Bullet
skills.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Bronya's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Combat Redeployment
skills.desc:
Dispels a debuff from a single ally, allows them to immediately take action, and increases their DMG by #1[i]% for #3[i] turn(s).
When this Skill is used on Bronya herself, she cannot immediately take action again.

skills.name: The Belobog March
skills.desc: Increases the ATK of all allies by #1[i]%, and increases their CRIT DMG equal to #2[f1]% of Bronya's CRIT DMG plus #3[f1]% for #4[i] turn(s).

skills.name: Leading the Way
skills.desc: After using her Basic ATK, Bronya's next action will be Advanced Forward by #1[i]%.

skills.name: Banner of Command
skills.desc: After using Bronya's Technique, at the start of the next battle, all allies' ATK increases by #1[i]% for #2[i] turn(s).

passives.name: Command
passives.desc: The CRIT Rate for Basic ATK increases to 100%.

passives.name: Battlefield
passives.desc: At the start of the battle, all allies' DEF increases by 20% for 2 turn(s).

passives.name: Military Might
passives.desc: When Bronya is on the field, all allies deal 10% more DMG.
